issues: [Med/Repetition & monotony] Constant smiling from the café staff — The barista or waiter smiles at Maya in almost every interaction across scenes 4, 5, 7, 8, and 9. It becomes noticeably repetitive, especially since Scene 5 and Scene 9 both open with the exact same line: 'Baristaen smiler til mig.' The staff begins to feel robotic.

[Low/Repetition & monotony] Repetitive 'klar til' scene endings — Scenes 3, 5, and 9 all end with a variation of Maya announcing she is 'ready' for the next thing ('klar til at bestille', 'klar til en god pause', 'klar til kulden'). This creates a slightly predictable, formulaic wrap-up for these scenes.

[Med/Repetition & monotony] The barista/staff member is described as smiling in almost every interaction. — Across scenes 4, 5, 7, 8, and 9, the staff member smiles at Maya seven times (e.g., 'Baristaen smiler til mig' opens both Scene 5 and Scene 9). While politeness is the theme, noting his smile in every single scene becomes a noticeable, monotonous refrain.

[High/Naive whole-week listener (no checklist)] Severe English gloss mismatch for 'Jeg finder tilbage til mit bord ved vinduet.' — The Danish means 'I find my way back to my table by the window', but the English gloss says 'The table is close to the radiator.' As a learner, I would wrongly deduce that 'vinduet' means 'radiator' and 'mit bord' means 'close to', severely confusing my vocabulary acquisition.

[Low/Naive whole-week listener (no checklist)] Excessively drawn-out description of walking back to the table. — There are four back-to-back sentences describing a 5-meter walk ('I walk very carefully. I walk slowly across the floor. I walk back to my table. I find my way back to my table...'). Even for A1 comprehensible input, this makes the pacing feel slightly robotic and drags the action.

[High/Cross-scene continuity & consistency] Translation mismatch due to cross-scene context bleed — The Danish line 'Jeg finder tilbage til mit bord ved vinduet.' is incorrectly glossed as 'The table is close to the radiator.' The model clearly hallucinated the English gloss by improperly pulling a detail established in Scene 2.
